plan.title: Donation Summary 2024
plan.subtitle: Key metrics and trends for the annual report

panels.title: Total Donations
panels.sql: SELECT SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM "donor_transactions" WHERE "Date" LIKE '2024%'

panels.title: Donations by City
panels.sql: SELECT "City", SUM("Amount") AS total FROM "donor_transactions" WHERE "Date" LIKE '2024%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Monthly Donation Trend
panels.sql: SELECT SUBSTR("Date", 1, 7) AS month, SUM("Amount") AS total FROM "donor_transactions" WHERE "Date" LIKE '2024%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top Donors
panels.sql: SELECT "Donor", SUM("Amount") AS total FROM "donor_transactions" WHERE "Date" LIKE '2024%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: Total donations for the year reached {{p1}}. The highest contributions came from {{p2.0}}, accounting for a significant portion of the total. Monthly trends show consistent activity throughout the year, with peaks in {{p3.0}}. The top donor, {{p4.0}}, contributed {{p4.1}}.
